title: KestrelCare Plan Holder Credit on Kestrel Auto Finance Returned-Payment Fees
content:
A borrower on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts who protects the financed vehicle with KestrelCare plans receives a protection-plan credit on a returned-payment fee: a flat dollar amount subtracted from the fee. It follows the borrower's KestrelCare plans:

- an active KestrelCare service contract (KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts) financed in this finance contract, together with an active KestrelCare prepaid maintenance plan (KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans) held by the borrower, takes the two-plan returned-payment credit, **4.00**;
- an active KestrelCare service contract financed in this finance contract without an active KestrelCare prepaid maintenance plan takes the one-plan returned-payment credit, **2.00**;
- any other borrower takes no credit.

## Combinations

| Active service contract financed in this contract | Active prepaid maintenance plan | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 4.00 |
| yes | no | 2.00 |
| no | yes | none |
| no | no | none |

## Points of judgement

- The service contract must be financed in this finance contract and its status must be active; a service contract not financed in this finance contract, or whose status is anything other than active, does not qualify.
- A maintenance plan counts only while its status is active.
- Hypothetical: a fee of 46.50 before this credit, for a borrower with both plans active, comes to 42.50.
